title: Measuring complex bodies and checking every number

say: Measuring complex bodies, and checking every number.
This is the video for module two of Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Making.
Two women with a 100 cm bust can need completely different patterns. Shape measurements reveal where each body carries its width.

say: Posture matters too. One client leans back, another rounds her shoulders. These decide where wrinkles will appear.

say: Take the high bust high under the arms, and the full bust over the fullest part. Ask her to wear the bra she will wear with the garment.
For example, Ngozi in Port Harcourt measures a client: high bust 92 cm, full bust 104 cm.

panel.heading: Ngozi reads the bust numbers
items: High bust 92 cm, full bust 104 cm
Difference: 104 minus 92 = 12 cm
Frame is closer to a 92 cm body
Bust span 20 cm: 10 cm each side
Bust depth 27 cm sets dart height

say: The difference is 12 cm. That is large.

panel.heading: Ngozi reads the bust numbers
items: High bust 92 cm, full bust 104 cm
Difference: 104 minus 92 = 12 cm

Bust span 20 cm: 10 cm each side
Bust depth 27 cm sets dart height

say: So her shoulders and back are closer to a 92 cm body. Drafting from 104 would make the neckline too wide and the armhole gape.

say: Ask her to stand naturally, and look from the front, side and back.
A deep hollow at the lower back is a sway back. It gives folds above the back waist, so shorten the back waist length.

panel.heading: Posture predicts pattern changes
items: Sway back: shorten back waist length
Rounded upper back: more back length
Full tummy: extra front length and width
Prominent seat: deeper back darts, length
Uneven shoulders: adjust one side

say: A rounded upper back makes the back pull up, so it needs more back length and width.

Uneven shoulders: adjust one side

say: A full tummy makes the front hem rise. The front needs extra length and width.

say: Use neutral words. Say, your back has a lovely curve, so I will shorten the back waist. Never make her feel judged.

say: Front, side and back photos help you compare fittings. Take them only with clear permission, in fitted everyday clothing, keep them locked, and delete them when the order is complete.

panel.heading: Body photos: only with consent
left: Delete when the order is done

say: Never take them undressed, and never post them or send them to anyone. Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023 sets duties for anyone handling personal data.

panel.heading: Body photos: only with consent
left: Delete when the order is done

say: Imported size charts often do not match your clients, especially at the hip. Build your own from your cards, using numbers instead of names.

panel.heading: Build a chart from your own clients
items: Copy bust, waist, hip from client cards
Sort by bust; find the biggest cluster
Base size where most clients are
Choose an interval from your data
Publish body and finished garment charts

say: Cross-checks catch errors. Take bust, waist and hip twice. If readings differ by more than about 1 cm, take a third. Then measure a garment she loves.
For example, Chioma in Abuja measures a bust of 98 cm and a hip of 104 cm.

panel.heading: Chioma catches a wrong number
items: Measured: bust 98 cm, hip 104 cm
Her favourite dress: 100 cm at hip
A woven dress cannot be smaller
Re-measured hip: 98 cm
A 6 cm error caught before cutting

say: The client's well-fitting dress measures 50 cm flat at the hip. Doubled, that is 100 cm around.

panel.heading: Chioma catches a wrong number
items: Measured: bust 98 cm, hip 104 cm
Her favourite dress: 100 cm at hip
A woven dress cannot be smaller
Re-measured hip: 98 cm
A 6 cm error caught before cutting

say: That is smaller than her measured hip, which is impossible for a woven dress without stretch. So one number is wrong.

panel.heading: Chioma catches a wrong number

say: Chioma re-measures with the client's feet together and gets 98 cm. The tape had dipped at the back.

say: She corrects the card, writes the date, and never overwrites old numbers. A 6 cm error was caught, and the client never knew.

say: To remember. Compare high bust and full bust. Observe posture from three sides, and use respectful words. Take body photos only with consent.
Build size charts from your own clients. And cross-check every number, retake when it is outside tolerance, and date every record.
